newsitem.title: UK: Reunion Mining starts gold output in Zambia.
newsitem.headline: Reunion Mining starts gold output in Zambia.

text.p: Britain's Reunion Mining Plc said on Tuesday its Dunrobin gold mine in Zambia had started production which is expected to build up to about 1,600 ounces per month by the end of the year.
The Dunrobin Gold Mine is situated in 120 km west of Lusaka in central Zambia. Proven and probable reserves amount to 1.2 million tonnes at 2.1 grams/tonne, sufficient for three years of production.
"However, additional unproven ore is known to exist in the area and this should extend the mine's life," the company said.
Reunion said over 50 percent of production has been hedged at price of 365 dollars per ounce and operating costs were expected to be 160 dollars per ounce.
